open.thesis: Split out of the validator-drift thesis, which was closed today on its validator half. RUNBOOK.md KNOWN LIMITATIONS still reads 'seasonProj is assumed live, not proven ... if two snapshots days apart show identical numbers, it is a preseason artifact.' That is settled and settled the other way: chem-seasonproj-live-2026-09-21 proved the field recomputes after each slate by diffing two commits, 245 of 250 season projections changed. A run that follows the runbook literally here will under-trust a live field. The REAL limitation, observed again today, is different and narrower: seasonProj does not price AVAILABILITY.
